HOW THE QUADSTICK WORKS

My mouth.
My controller.

A closer look at the setup that lets me jump into a match, explore a new world, and play alongside my friends.

A CLOSER LOOK AT THE CONTROLLER

THE BASICS

Here’s how I play.

My QuadStick lets me play using my mouth. In my setup, I sip or puff through three main openings in the mouthpiece to activate different commands. Different combinations let me perform different actions.

I also move the joystick with my mouth and use a lip control beneath the mouthpiece that I activate with my bottom lip. I can customize the controls for different games.

Explore official QuadStick information ↗
01

Sip & puff

Breathing in or out through the mouthpiece activates commands. Different combinations give me more options.

02

Move the joystick

I move the joystick with my mouth. What that movement does depends on the controls I’ve set for the game.

03

Use my bottom lip

The lip control gives me another input, right beneath the mouthpiece.
